name: Oni Kantoku to Ore no Kanojo ~Joyuu no Tamago ga Oni Kantoku to Nikutai Kankei o Musunda Riyuu~
original_name: 鬼監督と俺の彼女～女優の卵が鬼監督と肉体関係を結んだ理由～
source:
Shimura Juku was a renowned theatrical group that sponsored famous actors. They held seminars on the 8th floor of an upscale shopping complex where Kenichi Takasuka (protagonist) was studying drama. One day he met a girl loitering outside a seminar on how to overcome stage anxiety.
Her name was Asako Ikemoto (heroine).

They talked for a while. Asako wanted to become an actress. They soon fell in love.

Then.

The "demon director".
He was the famous heavy hitter of Nanpa Productions. He'd grown fat and lost his enthusiasm for film. He loved the casting couch, though.

"My dick is magic," he bragged.
"Women fall on it for a chance in the biz," he snorted.
"They're all cum sluts. Am I wrong?" he belched.
These were his warped views from his powerful position.

He would attend auditions and exploit the hopeful naivete of young girls.

Girls like Asako. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE092739.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
志村塾是一个培养出著名演员的知名剧团。他们在一家高档商场的八楼举办研讨会，高须健一（主人公）正在那里学习戏剧。一天，他在“如何克服舞台恐惧”的研讨会外遇到了一个徘徊的女孩。她的名字叫池本朝子（女主角）。他们聊了一会儿。朝子想成为一名演员。他们很快坠入爱河。然后——“鬼导演”。他是南波制作公司的著名大腕。他变得肥胖，失去了对电影的热情。但他喜欢潜规则。“我的鸡巴是魔力。”他吹嘘道。“女人为了在业界的机会扑上来。”他嗤笑道。“她们都是肉便器。我说错了吗？”他打着嗝说。这些就是他凭借权势地位而扭曲的观念。他会参加试镜，利用年轻女孩的天真。像朝子这样的女孩。
